title: Technical Program Manager, Product Security
Senior Staff Infrastructure & Security Engineer
description_html:
<p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>ABOUT CIVILGRID</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>WHY THIS ROLE</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Partner with engineering to embed reliability and security into the SDLC and infrastructure decisions</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Run our security program: SOC 2 readiness and audits, vendor reviews, access controls, endpoint security, and threat modeling</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Define and enforce policies for identity, secrets, data handling, and production access across the company</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Lead incident response for both security events, and some reliability events, from detection through resolution and follow-up</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Harden and monitor our GIS servers (Windows Server) alongside our AWS platform</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Build and maintain our Trust Center, and lead security reviews with customers</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Contribute to our AWS environment end to end: VPC architecture, ECS, RDS, secrets management, IAM, networking, and cost optimization</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Contribute to improving reliability practices: SLOs, observability, alerting, on-call rotation, runbooks, and blameless post-incident reviews</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">The tech:</p><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS managed with CDK</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">GitHub, Datadog, Slack, Notion, Drata</p></li></ul></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BRING</strong></p><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">At least 5-8 years of experience across product security, platform security, or security engineering, with hands-on experience with DevOps or SRE of production AWS infrastructure</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Experience running or supporting a SOC 2 program, including evidence collection, control design, and auditor coordination</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Deep working knowledge of AWS (VPC, ECS, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent)</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Experience running vulnerability management, from scanner findings and outside reports to fixes shipped</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Track record of improving reliability in production: defining SLOs, building observability, running on-call, and leading post-incident reviews</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Startup ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively</p></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>BONUS POINTS</strong></p><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Experience supporting B2B products sold into regulated industries (utilities, energy, public sector)</p></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>HOW WE WORK</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers â huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>COMPENSATION & BENEFITS</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>The base salary range for this role is </strong><em>$137,318 - $192,960</em>.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.</p><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">In addition to base and equity, we offer:</p><ul style="min-height:1.5em"><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance â including medical plans at no cost to the employee</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">FSA (health and dependent care)</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">401(k) plan</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">Flexible, remote-friendly work environment</p></li><li><p style="min-height:1.5em">A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career</p></li></ul><p style="min-height:1.5em"></p><p style="min-height:1.5em"><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY</strong></p><p style="min-height:1.5em">CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us â we're happy to help.</p><br/><br/>Please mention the word **THINNER** and tag RNC4yNDIuNDUuMjI= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNC4yNDIuNDUuMjI=). title: Senior DevOps Platform Engineer
description_html: NVIDIA is building the computing platforms that power the next era of AI, and reliable software delivery is essential to operating them at scale. Join the team building NVIDIA’s AI Ops platform for large-scale AI infrastructure, where telemetry and operational capabilities help customers run complex AI factories. This role combines platform engineering, release ownership, and production operations across cloud, on-premises, Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, and air-gapped environments. The work spans the full path from a developer’s commit to a secure, observable customer deployment, with close partnership across engineering, QA, security, product, and support.    What you’ll be doing:    Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines and reusable developer-platform workflows that automate build, test, security scanning, publishing, deployment, and promotion across services.  Own release mechanics end to end, including versioning, artifact and image lifecycle, upgrades, rollbacks, and controlled rollout across environments.  Deploy and operate the platform across Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, AWS, on-premises infrastructure, and air-gapped customer environments; manage infrastructure as code and declarative GitOps across environments and accounts.  Integrate security into delivery through vulnerability scanning, secrets management, SBOM generation, and open-source license compliance.  Strengthen the reliability of containerized and stateful services through high availability, backup and restore, observability, dashboards, alerting, runbooks, and incident response; participate in cloud-service on-call as needed.  Improve engineering velocity and service maturity through faster builds, caching, reproducible environments, clear deployment standards, operational tooling, and better onboarding in partnership with engineering, QA, security, product, and support.     What we need to see:    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.  5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Release Engineering.  Hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform and Ansible; strong Linux and networking troubleshooting skills.  Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar tools, including artifact publishing and release workflows.  Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, image registries, and container lifecycle management; experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.  Practical DevSecOps experience integrating vulnerability scanning, secrets handling, SBOMs, and compliance checks into CI/CD workflows.  Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or similar, and experience with production observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Experience delivering software into on-premises or air-gapped customer environments.  Experience operating stateful distributed data services such as Kafka, MySQL, or Redis in production.  Background with GPU, HPC, AI, or other large-scale infrastructure platforms.  Experience building internal developer platforms that measurably improve engineering velocity and release reliability, or helping a product mature into a customer-facing SaaS offering.  Kubernetes or AWS certifications, or hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Kubernetes Platform
description_html: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and amazing people. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and sits at the heart of our products and services. Every one of those GPUs starts life inside our silicon design environment, and that environment runs on the platform this team builds.   We're looking for a Senior SRE to own and scale the Kubernetes platform that assists NVIDIA's chip design (EDA) workloads. This is not a generic container-platform role. You'll be running Kubernetes at the edges of what it was developed for: orchestrating enormous stateful jobs, license-constrained EDA tooling, latency-sensitive access to high-performance shared storage, and tenants whose tapeout schedules do not move. The clusters you run sit alongside some of the largest EDA compute farms in the industry, spanning multiple on-prem datacenters and multiple public clouds. When these clusters degrade, chip schedules feel it - which is exactly what makes the reliability work exciting.    What you'll be doing:    Own Kubernetes clusters end-to-end - plan, deliver, upgrade, day-2 operations, and decommission - across on-prem datacenters and managed cloud Kubernetes (e.g. EKS, GKE, RKE, Red Hat OpenShift, etc.).  Define and implement the multi-cluster lifecycle strategy: version skew policy, patch cadence, node image pipelines, controlled rollouts, and safe upgrade mechanics for clusters that can't simply be drained on demand.  Treat on-prem and CSP Kubernetes as one platform with consistent APIs, policy, and observability - not as two disconnected worlds.  Drive everything through Infrastructure-as-Code, GitOps, and declarative config; manual cluster changes should be an anomaly worth investigating.  Design for failure: explicit fault domains, blast-radius containment between clusters and tenants, progressive delivery, and disciplined change control.  Build end-to-end observability (metrics, logs, traces, events) and push toward data-driven and auto-healing operations that materially reduce human intervention.  Participate in on-call, lead incident response, drive root cause analysis, and publish high-quality RCAs that actually change the system.  Partner with EDA engineering, storage, and network teams to land changes cleanly in a fast-moving environment.  Engage and partner with data center operations to help forecast, design and implement the accurate on-prem and cloud deployments to meet architectural needs.   Interface directly with internal EDA tenants/engineering teams  to design and implement operational improvements to increase productivity and provide faster and more reliable outcomes as well as partner with the infrastructure services team to help architect the supporting  capabilities for intelligent workload routing, observability, dynamic scaling and resource governance.      What we need to see:    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years building and supporting critical production services.   Deep, hands-on Kubernetes operations experience - you've run it, not just consumed it. Comfortable debugging etcd, kubelet, CNI, CSI, scheduler behavior, API server load, container runtime, and control-plane degradation under real production pressure.    Production experience with CSP-managed Kubernetes — including its upgrade model, networking and IAM integration, node group lifecycle, and where the managed abstraction stops helping you.    Production experience operating self-managed Kubernetes on-premises across multiple datacenters — cluster bring-up, bare-metal and GPU node lifecycle, multi-site topology, and the failure modes that only show up when you own the whole stack.   Strong command of CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD/Flux or equivalents).  Demonstrated experience building large-scale infrastructure platforms for automated host lifecycle management, fleet reliability and auto-healing, end-to-end observability, or data-driven operations (AIOps/ML-driven signals) that measurably reduced toil.  Proficiency with monitoring, metrics,, and log collection tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki/ELK, containerd, etc.).  5+ years of coding/scripting focusing on automation and operational management at scale in at least two languages such as Go, Python, Perl, or Ruby - with Go a strong plus for controller and operator work.  Track record mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction through design reviews, architecture documents, and strong partnership with team members and leadership.  Creative problem solver with excellent debugging instincts and strong written communication.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Familiarity with EDA/silicon-design workflows, license management, or other license-constrained compute environments. You've written or built Kubernetes controllers, operators, admission webhooks, scheduler plugins, or device/CSI plugins that ran in production.  Experience running stateful, storage-heavy, or GPU-accelerated workloads on Kubernetes at scale.  Published technical write-ups or talks (conference presentations, meetups, engineering blogs) that deep-dive into real-world reliability, observability, or large-scale Kubernetes/HPC problems.  Maintainer or co-maintainer responsibilities for an open source component used in production at scale - operators, exporters, controllers, plugins, or SDKs.    We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you. ​   NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our invention serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is seeking exceptional individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence.     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 9, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
